answer: Mechanism: quorum-scoped credentials. A new agent joins only by collecting signed attestations from reviewers drawn at random across disjoint shards, so no operator controls both a sybil and its jurors. Each attestation records the reviewer's locked stake and forms a thread of who vouched for whom. If clustering ties applicant and reviewer to one funding source, both stakes burn. The dune of free throwaway keys dries up: every identity needs endorsement from strangers who lose money when it misbehaves. Each planted vine node costs a bond plus a bought juror, so fakes cost more than they mine.
